applicabilityBasis.summary: sUSDat represents proportional ERC-4626 shares in a managed credit vault. Its value and USDat payout per share vary with portfolio NAV and distributions, and exit is through a withdrawal queue. It is not designed as a fixed-monetary-value payment/settlement stablecoin. STRCon exposure does not by itself establish that sUSDat legally qualifies as an excluded security.

references.label: sUSDat V2 STRCon NAV and withdrawal runbook

genius.notes: Reviewed independently of parent USDat. The underlying USDat/PYUSDx payment-token question does not convert a variable-NAV managed credit-vault share into a payment stablecoin. Current V2 disclosures describe STRCon portfolio exposure and queued share-price-based USDat withdrawals. Operator/custody entities named in the migration runbook are not assigned as legal token issuer without an issuer undertaking.
